summary_claims.claim: Proposes eleven market surveillance authorities and two notifying authorities (Swedac and the Medical Products Agency), PTS with main responsibility.
Proposes that reprimands and administrative fines also be imposed on public authorities; IMY primarily responsible for prohibited practices.

note: Regeringen.se page and the full SOU PDF confirm SOU 2025:101 published 6 Oct 2025 with Dir. 2024:83 as the mandate and Fi2025/01969 as the consultation number. date_last_updated null is right: 23 Feb 2026 is the consultation page update, not a new version of the report. The related-documents panel shows no Council on Legislation referral and no bill; one targeted search found no proposition either. 'Published (non-binding, current)' holds.
